read_verification.method: The earlier source pass read the cited Saff §1 (through Theorem 1.12), §2 and §3 ranges as complete statements/proofs or explicit exercise/citation deferrals. To repair the uncovered Chebyshev block, on 2026-09-30 I fetched the complete 36-page arXiv v1 PDF, checked its printed-page labels, and extracted/read complete pp. 175–178 with PyMuPDF, including Proposition 1.13, the polynomial extremal problem, Lemma 1.14, Examples 1.15–1.17, and the full proof of Theorem 1.18(a)–(d). The PDF SHA-256 is cfbeaad8cf695fc1b5528fd56295d7e3053056634c6841765a434ce9b074d862; the formal fetch stamp records its matching 16-character prefix.
